notes.title: MAJ 1.1.12 Sound update
notes.content:
Hello, a new update is available!
Big changements come with it!

Again a big thanks to all beta-tester and steam reviewers!
[h1]
[b]Changelog:[/b][/h1]
	
[b]Changes[/b]
	- Traductions and langs :
A lot of mistack and incorrect traduction was removed from game langs
        - Sound update :
Lot of game evenement will now play sound, and musics are added to the game!

[b]Bug fixs:[/b]
	- An huge number of bug are corrected in new update
For the end, timeover is officialy published on steam !

notes.title: Update 1.1.8 Bug fix released
notes.content:
Hello, new update with lot of bug fixes, and some minor changes, stay update!
A big thanks to beta-testers for finded bugs!
[h1]
[b]Changelog:[/b][/h1]
	
[b]Changes:[/b]
	- Huge update on dialog API
		[i]Actions will be directly call at end of dialogs events
		Player can now skip dialog ( SkipDialogTouch will work properly )
		Dialog time increased to let play read them fully
		Dialog without end time added, player have to press next to skip ( for main story dialogs )[/i]
	- Receiving damage from mobs will apply him a knockback effect
	- Fullscreen toggle added in options
        - Delete save added in options
        - Auto updating save version cross game version

[b]Fixed bug:[/b]
	- Plateform on ground detection
	- Hero size block access on holl of size 1
- 	- Keep attacking a mob prevent him taking damage
	- When text of dialog box is to big, text-size didn't scale to text-size
	- Size of screen didn't fit to real play screen resolution
 	- Size of screen let player seen over his Y field of view
	- Performance improvement on dialogs
	- Lot of minor bug fixed
	- Fix knockback direction when hited by a mob if player is back to him
